content: Lightning gift-card systems commonly fail by using weak or seeded redemption tokens (e.g., LCGs, timestamps, Math.random, or truncated short hashes), storing tokens in plaintext, and skipping rate limits on public endpoints. Best practice is to generate opaque tokens with a CSPRNG (≥128 bits), store only hashes, compare with constant-time equality, and apply aggressive rate limiting and audit logging on every redemption attempt.
